title: The Rain Wilds Chronicles: A Thrilling Fantasy Series About Dragons in a World That Needs and Fears Them
author: Robin Hobb

highlights.text: Death fed life. He was meat now, and all hers.
Well, he was a fool if he thought he could conceal anything from a dragon.
“It’s going to be all right. I’ve got you, my friend. We’ll be fine.”
“We’re nearly there. We’re nearly home,” she said, and it did not seem at all a strange thing for her to say.
How could humans seriously believe that a dragon could be interested in the details of their lives? As well worry about a moth or a fish.
Thymara would obey. It was what keepers did. It was really all they were good for.
“I was such a fool.” Sedric shook his head. “I deserve to be tormented.”
One hundred years here? Living in a little cottage and caring for his eccentric dragon. Would that be his life?
At our ages, we desire to be wed quickly and quietly, but neither of our families seems so inclined. Pity us!
To build a throne, you must build on stone, not flowers. I am stone.”
“We would like to believe the Elderlings were always wise and kind, but their roots were human. They had their failings.”
There was the old Tarman, the ugliest liveship ever built, as evidence.
“He made no cry for vengeance when I was the one who was dying,” she observed sourly to her Elderling. “Yet let them succeed in giving him a bellyache, and he will melt all their cities with venom.”
The old saying is true. ‘Sooner or later, there is always war with Chalced.’ It is all they know there. And better that we take war to them than that they bring it to us again.
